The Fountain of Life Church, Lagos, has removed Pastor Jimmy Odukoya as its senior pastor, citing a video recording in which its late founder, Pastor Taiwo Odukoya, outlined a different succession arrangement before his death. The church’s Board of Trustees announced the decision in a statement on Tuesday, saying a review of the recording and the church’s constitution showed that Taiwo had designated another person to succeed him. According to the board, the video was recorded in December 2021 by Jimmy at his father’s request but was not presented when the trustees initially sought information about the founder’s succession plans. The board said the late pastor had appointed Jimmy as administrative assistant to his chosen successor and head of the youth church, with the arrangements to take effect upon his death or inability to communicate. It said Jimmy’s appointment as senior pastor following his father’s death in August 2023 was based on the information available to the trustees at the time. “The Board has undertaken a careful consideration of the recording, the circumstances in which it was made and the relevant provisions of the Church’s Constitution,” the statement said. The trustees added that their review confirmed that Taiwo had exercised his succession authority and communicated his intentions before his death. The board also disclosed that it had made efforts to resolve the disagreement privately through meetings with respected religious leaders, but alleged that Jimmy rejected the advice offered during the reconciliation process. “The Board has not acted in haste. Since the video came to light, the Board has sought a peaceful and private resolution of these matters,” it stated. The trustees further cited concerns over Jimmy’s recent remarriage and its public blessing, describing the development as contrary to the church’s teachings, the values of its founders and the standards expected of its spiritual leadership. Following its meeting on November 16, 2026, the trustees resolved to implement the late founder’s recorded instructions and realign the church’s leadership structure. “Consequently, Pastor Jimmy Odukoya is no longer recognised as the Senior Pastor of The Fountain of Life Church effective immediately,” the statement added. explaining that it followed a review of the church’s constitution and documented instructions left by the founder before his death in 2023. According to the board, the review was aimed at ensuring that the church’s leadership transition reflected the wishes of its late founder and complied with the provisions governing its operations. “Following a careful consideration of the relevant provisions of the Church’s Constitution and a review of the recorded instructions of our beloved Founder, the Board of Trustees has resolved to give effect to the succession arrangements which he made prior to his demise in 2023,” the statement said. The trustees described the development as an institutional decision taken in the discharge of their responsibilities and in the interest of the church. They maintained that the action was necessary to uphold the church’s constitution, respect the intentions of its founder and protect the integrity of the succession framework he established. “It is an institutional decision taken in the discharge of the Board’s responsibilities and in the best interests of the Church,” the statement added. The board, however, assured members that the decision would not affect the church’s activities, saying its governance structures remained intact and that worship services, pastoral care and other ministry programmes would continue without interruption. It also appealed to members to remain peaceful and united, stressing that the church’s mission transcended individual officeholders. The board did not, however, disclose further details of the succession arrangements or announce who would assume the senior pastor position. Jimmy’s removal comes against the backdrop of the deaths of both his parents, the leadership transition that followed and renewed attention to his personal life. His mother, Pastor Bimbo Odukoya, who co-founded The Fountain of Life Church with her husband in 1992, died on December 11, 2005, from injuries sustained in the Sosoliso Airlines Flight 1145 crash in Port Harcourt. Her husband, Taiwo, later married South African pastor Nomthi Zulu in 2010. However, Nomthi died in November 2021 after battling cancer for about two years. Taiwo subsequently died on August 7, 2023, in the United States, aged 67, less than two years after losing his second wife. Following his death, Jimmy was announced as the church’s senior pastor in September 2023 and was formally installed later that month. The actor-turned-pastor, who was previously married to Oluwakemi Banjoko, with whom he has two children, recently remarried. He introduced his new wife, Mo Jasyme, to the congregation during a Sunday service on November 1, 2026, after sharing a photograph of two hands wearing wedding rings with the caption, ‘To New Beginnings’. During the service, Jimmy told worshippers that he had been alone since assuming leadership of the church and had eventually found someone suitable. Pastor Tunde Bakare of The Citadel Global Community Church, who blessed the couple’s marriage in the United States, also introduced the new bride to the congregation as Pastor Mo Odukoya. The remarriage generated public debate, particularly over the circumstances surrounding the end of Jimmy’s previous marriage and the implications of remarriage for Christian ministers. The controversy also drew attention to differing religious views on divorce and remarriage, with some clerics and members of the public expressing divergent positions.
